description_en: Invoke StopRCInstance to stop a running RDS Custom instance. After the API is successfully invoked, the instance transitions from the Stopping state to the Stopped state.
description_zh: 调用StopRCInstance停止一台运行中（Running）的RDS Custom实例。成功调用接口后，实例从暂停中（Stopping）变成已暂停（Stopped）状态
kebab_example: aliyun rds stop-rc-instance --instance-id rc-m5sc1271fv344a1r0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopRCInstance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully stop the instance. Valid values:

true
false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制关机。取值范围：

true：强制关机。

false（默认）：正常关机
parameters.name: force_stop

parameters.help_en:
The stop mode to use when stopping the instance. Valid values:

StopCharging: economical mode. When economical mode is enabled:
    - Computing resources are no longer billed.
    - System disk and data disk continue to be billed.
    - Because computing resources are revoked, the instance might fail to start due to insufficient inventory. In this case, try again later or change the instance type.

KeepCharging: normal stop mode. The instance continues to incur charges after it is stopped.
parameters.help_zh:
停止实例时，设置的停止模式。取值：

StopCharging：节省停机模式。开启节省停机模式后：
    - 计算资源暂停计费。
    - 系统盘、数据盘持续计费。
    - 由于计算资源被回收，启动时可能因库存不足导致启动失败，请您稍后再试或更换实例规格。 

KeepCharging：普通停机模式。实例停止后仍继续收费
parameters.name: stopped_mode
